entries.note: Official National Privacy Commission text re-verified on 2026-08-19. The page records approval on 2012-08-15 and remains the canonical Registry source for Republic Act No. 10173.
Official National Privacy Commission IRR text re-verified on 2026-08-19. The official text records promulgation on 2016-08-24; the NPC release states effectivity is 15 days after publication.

Signed NPC Circular 2023-06 and the current NPC issuance index were re-verified on 2026-08-19. The signed circular is dated 2023-12-01; the NPC publication notice confirms effectivity on 2024-03-30 and repeal of Circular 16-01.
Signed NPC Advisory 2025-02 and the current NPC advisory index were re-verified on 2026-08-19. The signed advisory is dated 2025-08-27 and remains listed as current privacy-engineering guidance.

EUR-Lex re-verified Regulation (EU) 2016/679 as in force. Date semantics were corrected to distinguish signature 2016-04-27, Official Journal publication 2016-05-04, entry into force 2016-05-24, and application from 2018-05-25.

Justice Laws states that PIPEDA is current to 2026-06-14 and last amended on 2025-03-04, while separately listing amendments not yet in force. Part 1 entered into force on 2001-01-01. Pending provisions are not treated as current obligations.

Federal Register of Legislation re-verified the Privacy Act 1988 as in force. Assent was 1988-12-14, commencement 1989-01-01, and the latest reviewed compilation is C2026C00227 C104 effective 2026-06-04.

Singapore Statutes Online re-verified the current PDPA text. The Act was published in the Acts Supplement on 2012-12-03, principal Parts III-VII commenced on 2014-07-02, the latest reviewed text is current as at 2026-08-07, and the latest timeline amendment is 2025-12-05.
